title: Financial operations copilot review
review_question: Could manipulated source content mislead a payment-change decision, and what should staff independently verify?
retrieval_focus: Vendor email and payment instruction manipulation misleading staff who prepare payment changes, with cited answers that look authoritative
system_description: A copilot retrieves vendor emails and internal payment instructions to help staff prepare a payment change. It recommends account details in a cited answer; it cannot move funds.
users_and_roles: Finance staff who prepare payment changes
tools_and_permissions: Search vendor email and payment instructions
Return a cited recommendation to the requesting staff member
existing_controls: A second staff member approves each payment change outside the copilot
constraints: The copilot has no payment execution permission
Staff may rely heavily on the cited answer
unknowns: Whether account changes are re-verified against the vendor master record
Whether displayed citations are checked by staff
